tailoring.headline: Business Analyst – SAP Commerce (Hybris) Specialist | 5+ Years E-Commerce Delivery
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Backoffice, HAC, OCC REST APIs, PIM/ERP/MDM integrations and production issue investigation. Strong techno-functional consulting: requirements analysis, user stories, process mapping and AI-assisted documentation. Proven record of optimizing data pipelines, supporting global e-commerce platforms and mentoring teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Business Analyst (SAP Commerce / Hybris) | Contract
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Techholding’s ambition to strengthen its SAP Commerce platform. With 5+ years of hands-on SAP Commerce (Hybris) delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built and supported robust back-office and API solutions that drive commerce excellence.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Expertise
bullets.text: I worked in a techno-functional role at Rockwell, analysing business requirements, writing user stories and translating them into SAP Commerce solutions, directly matching your need for business analysis.

bullets.label: Production Issue Resolution
bullets.text: I investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks and production incidents across SAP ERP, MDM and Hybris, ensuring high availability for global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Backoffice & HAC Customisation
bullets.text: I customized Backoffice components and used the Hybris Administration Console (HAC) to implement data pipelines and admin tools, aligning with your focus on Backoffice and HAC expertise.

bullets.label: Integration & API Design
bullets.text: I designed OCC REST APIs and PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines, delivering seamless data flow between ERP, MDM and the storefront, which supports your integration requirements.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Techholding.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung: Business Analyst (SAP Commerce / Hybris) | Vertrag
cover_de.hook: Die Vision von Techholding, die SAP-Commerce-Plattform weiter zu stärken, begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Praxis in SAP Commerce (Hybris) bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich robuste Backoffice- und API-Lösungen entwickelt, die den Commerce-Erfolg sichern.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Expertise
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell habe ich in einer techno-funktionalen Rolle Geschäftsanforderungen analysiert, User Stories erstellt und in SAP-Commerce-Lösungen umgesetzt – exakt das, was Sie suchen.

bullets.label: Produktions-Issue-Lösung
bullets.text: Ich habe Integrationsengpässe und Produktionsprobleme zwischen SAP ERP, MDM und Hybris untersucht und behoben, um eine hohe Verfügbarkeit sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Backoffice- & HAC-Anpassungen
bullets.text: Ich habe Backoffice-Komponenten angepasst und die Hybris Administration Console (HAC) genutzt, um Datenpipelines und Admin-Tools zu implementieren, passend zu Ihrem Fokus.

bullets.label: Integration & API-Design
bullets.text: Ich habe OCC-REST-APIs und PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines entworfen, um nahtlose Datenflüsse zwischen ERP, MDM und dem Storefront zu gewährleisten.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15. Dezember 2026 und kann ab dem 16. Dezember 2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zu Techholding zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: Techholding’s focus on scaling SAP Commerce platforms for industrial clients aligns perfectly with my experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, where I optimized PIM-ERP integrations, resolved production issues and delivered high-performance Hybris solutions that drive revenue and operational efficiency.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Techholding accelerate its SAP Commerce roadmap by applying my proven Hybris integration and production-support expertise.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce (Hybris) specialist with 5+ years delivering robust e-commerce solutions. I’d love to discuss how I can help Techholding strengthen its platform. Let’s connect!
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will streamline your SAP Commerce back-office processes, enhance OCC APIs and ensure seamless PIM-ERP data synchronization, drawing on my recent work on data pipelines and production support at Rockwell Automation. My AI-assisted development approach will also accelerate delivery of new features.
tailoring.insight: Your posting highlights the need for deep Backoffice and HAC expertise to quickly resolve production incidents. My proven track record in investigating and fixing integration bottlenecks in SAP Commerce will reduce downtime and improve system stability.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Business Analyst (SAP Commerce / Hybris) – Contract
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce (Hybris) specialist with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Techholding’s commitment to strengthening its SAP Commerce platform resonates with my experience in Backoffice, HAC and production issue resolution. I can immediately contribute by optimizing integrations and ensuring stable operations. I have attached my CV and cover letter for your review.
